basics.name: Emmett Brown
basics.label: Inventor & Theoretical Physicist
basics.summary: Visionary inventor and theoretical physicist, renowned for pioneering work in time travel, flux capacitor technology, and unconventional scientific research.

work.name: Hill Valley Laboratory
highlights: Invented the Flux Capacitor, enabling practical time travel.
Designed and constructed the DeLorean Time Machine.
Conducted experiments in temporal mechanics and quantum theory.

work.name: Pacific Science Institute
highlights: Led a team investigating applied electromagnetism.
Co-authored seven peer-reviewed articles on electromagnetic field theory.

awards.title: Lifetime Achievement in Innovation
awards.summary: For a lifetime of inventive contributions to science and engineering.

awards.title: Best Experimental Demonstration
awards.summary: Awarded for the live demonstration of the DeLorean Time Machine prototype.

publications.name: The Flux Capacitor: A New Era in Temporal Mechanics
publications.summary: Keynote on the invention and implications of the flux capacitor.

references.name: Marty McFly
references.reference: Long-term collaborator and field assistant in temporal experiments.

references.name: Clara Clayton
references.reference: Advisor on science communication and educational outreach.
